blocks.heading: [green:TECHNICAL] [gold:HUB]
blocks.subheading: [green:TECHNICAL] [gold:HUB] has established itself as one of India's leading industry-oriented skill development ecosystems, with a mission to bridge the gap between academia and industry. Since its inception in 2016, the organization has evolved into a comprehensive technology, innovation, certification, and career acceleration platform.

blocks.tagline: Building skilled careers. Creating better tomorrows.
blocks.body: Every engineer has a story. Mine runs from a small town in Andhra Pradesh, across three continents, and back home again — to build the bridge between campus and industry.
blocks.alt: Babji Neelam, Founder & CEO of Technical Hub and Torii

panels.title: Technology Foundation
panels.summary: Babji began his technology career as a software engineer, gaining hands-on experience in enterprise technology and software development. His early international experience included working with banking systems in Australia and Switzerland, building the technical foundation that would later shape his leadership approach.

panels.title: Global Delivery Leadership
panels.summary: After building strong technical expertise, Babji moved into leadership and project management at Wipro, where he spent around a decade. Working across complex technology environments strengthened his capabilities in delivery, teams, execution, problem-solving, and leadership.

panels.title: Entrepreneurial Vision
panels.summary: After more than 12 years in IT, Babji made a deliberate decision in 2015 to leave the corporate comfort zone and return to his roots in Andhra Pradesh. His purpose was clear: bridge the gap between what industry needs and what academia teaches. After months of research, planning and preparation, TECHNICAL HUB was officially started on 2 February 2016.

panels.title: Ecosystem Builder
panels.summary: What began as a vision to connect academia and industry evolved into a broader technology and skill-development ecosystem. TECHNICAL HUB grew around industry certifications, practical learning, projects, placements, technology partnerships and innovation, reaching thousands of students — particularly from rural and tier-2/3 backgrounds. His 2026 reflection highlights the impact: students from the ecosystem have progressed into companies including Google, Amazon, Walmart, Cisco, Flipkart, Myntra, Airbus, DBS Bank, AWS and AMD, among others.

panels.title: AI & Innovation Leadership
panels.summary: The next chapter moves beyond traditional skilling toward AI, innovation and enterprise transformation. Babji’s recent leadership journey includes the evolution of TECHNICAL HUB’s AI ecosystem and its official Anthropic Claude Partner milestone — an opportunity he attributes to years of consistent preparation, experimentation and perseverance. Alongside this evolution, he has also begun a new entrepreneurial chapter with Torii, describing it as a new space for new challenges, new places, new innovations and new dreams.
